candidates.name: Coffee Textured Long-Sleeve Shirt
candidates.decisionReason: The woven surface and controlled relaxed body are credible for Casual or Travel, but the long open overshirt, large patch pocket, backpack styling and visible base T-shirt do not communicate a self-contained Luxury Office garment.

candidates.name: Green Textured Long-Sleeve Shirt
candidates.decisionReason: The saturated green is lively, but the hanger composition provides no body-fit proof and the shiny crinkled surface looks inexpensive. It cannot establish Luxury textile, drape or construction.

candidates.name: Muted-Blue Twin-Pocket Shirt
candidates.decisionReason: The worn source proves regular ease, but the washed muted finish, two large flap pockets, long open body and dark base T-shirt make this a utility overshirt for Casual or Travel rather than Luxury Office.

candidates.name: Light-Blue Ribbed Short-Sleeve Knit
candidates.decisionReason: The cropped isolated image cannot prove full-body proportion, while the narrow sleeve opening, close torso and bunched waist suggest a fitted dated knit. No Luxury fiber or finish is visually demonstrated.

candidates.name: Brown Long-Sleeve Knit Polo
candidates.decisionReason: The body has reasonable ease, but the dark flat knit, bright oversized buttons and heavily bunched cuffs read mass-market rather than Luxury, while the brown adds more gloom to a Spring palette.

candidates.name: White Textured Knit Crew T-Shirt
candidates.decisionReason: The clean texture and relaxed body suit Summer Casual, but the broad dropped-shoulder T-shirt shape and casual five-pocket styling lack the refined collar, fiber and structure required for Luxury Office.

candidates.name: Light-Gray Relaxed Trouser
candidates.decisionReason: Only a product image is available, so rise, drape and shoe break remain unknown. Diagonal knee seams, a snap waist and a wrinkled synthetic-looking surface read technical rather than Luxury tailoring.

candidates.name: Ivory Straight-Leg Jean
candidates.decisionReason: The warm ivory can serve Spring Casual, but the product-only image gives no worn fit or hem proof and the broad five-pocket denim construction is not the wool-silk tailored trouser required here.

candidates.name: Medium-Blue Straight-Leg Jean
candidates.decisionReason: The leg is broad and long enough to stack over the sneaker, while the conventional denim finish is casual. It fails the precise controlled drape expected of Luxury Office tailoring.

candidates.name: Military-Green Casual Trouser
candidates.decisionReason: The flat product source offers no fit proof, and the shiny wrinkled olive fabric plus novelty multicolor bead attachment visibly reduce refinement.

candidates.name: Flax-Coffee Lightweight Trouser
candidates.decisionReason: The gathered elastic waist, exposed black drawstring, crinkled lounge fabric, broad leg and puddled hem are incompatible with Luxury Office tailoring.

candidates.name: Yellow-Green Straight-Leg Jean
candidates.decisionReason: The dirty acid wash, streetwear finish, extremely broad leg and heavy sneaker puddling directly violate the clean controlled Luxury silhouette.

candidates.name: Sky-Blue Unstructured Button-Up Jacket
candidates.decisionReason: The sky blue is the right emotional direction, but the rumpled thin linen-like surface, casual rolled cuffs, chest pocket and jeans presentation look Resort-level rather than Luxury Office tailoring.

candidates.name: Khaki Single-Breasted Blazer
candidates.decisionReason: The body is extremely long and boxy, the sleeves overrun the wrist, and the thin flat fabric with low patch pockets lacks Luxury drape and construction.

candidates.name: White Button-Up Blazer
candidates.decisionReason: The cleaner regular line can serve Summer Smart Casual, but the washed lightweight surface, long bunched sleeves, T-shirt pairing and generic patch-pocket build do not prove Luxury fiber or finish.

candidates.name: Green Striped Button-Up Cardigan
candidates.decisionReason: The fitted waist and sleeves recreate a dated skinny silhouette, and the heavy green, burgundy, black and cream stripes are visually busy rather than quiet modern Luxury.

candidates.name: Taupe Faux-Leather Zip Shacket
candidates.decisionReason: The controlled hip-length shape can work in Fall Casual, but the mottled faux-leather surface, exposed zipper, snap hardware and graphic T-shirt styling cannot meet a Luxury Office material gate.

candidates.name: Khaki Double-Breasted Trench
candidates.decisionReason: The trench belongs in Rainy Day or Travel: its strongly dropped shoulder, very long oversized body and streetwear styling overwhelm the controlled Luxury Office proportion.
